GCODING.item: * 1. Get the data from KNA1 using the Input Parameter
SELECT kunnr land1 name1 ort01 umsat adrnr
INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_KNA1
* 2. Fill the Work Area for the first record
READ TABLE IT_KNA1 INTO wa_kna1 INDEX 1.
" Now get the address using the field we just fetched
APPEND INITIAL LINE TO IT_KNA1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>).
